title: Start With the Room
author: Agile Lens
source: Original text created for the Understudy sample pack, October 28, 2026. Not a quotation or a device-readiness claim.

entries.text: Original rehearsal text. Pause and resume at your own pace.
Before we talk about a new tool, look at the room. People found seats. Someone moved a cable. Someone made sure the door would open.
That work is easy to miss because it worked. Good tools have a similar problem. When they help, the task becomes the story.
Today I want to show three small tasks. We will try each one, look at what happened, and say where it still breaks.
You do not need to agree with my conclusions. Watch for the moment when you would reach for a different tool.
If we can name that moment clearly, this hour will have been useful. Let us start with something we can test together.
